_about: Map model for site/public/index.html. Edited by hand; tools/build_map_data.py merges it with integrations/integration-register.yaml into build/map.json, which is uploaded to the private Supabase bucket. Never deploy this file.

header.eyebrow: Finance Technology Group · Current state · Oracle Fusion 26C
header.title: Oracle Finance Estate Map
header.lede: Many systems originate transactions, many Oracle modules record them, and everything narrows into one accounting engine and one ledger family. Select any system to see what it owns, how it connects and where it breaks.

nodes.title: Zip
nodes.subtitle: intake & workflow
nodes.description: Every purchase request starts here. Runs the review graph (risk, privacy, legal, BizTech, sustainability) and defaults COA segments. Advisory only: Oracle re-derives the account.
failure_modes: Spend category inactive in Oracle, so the requisition never arrives
Wrong entity or cost center found after the PO exists
INT826 user-entry errors: REQ number instead of PO

nodes.title: Apex portal
nodes.subtitle: PO-supplier onboarding
nodes.description: Supplier-facing onboarding for PO suppliers: questionnaires, risk, diversity, bank and tax detail. A PO supplier exists in Oracle only after Apex.
failure_modes: Missing crosswalk row or lookup value fails the record

nodes.title: Supplier Registration Request
nodes.subtitle: Oracle · non-PO payees
nodes.description: Internal Redwood registration for ad hoc, one-time and Treasury payees. INT959 completes the supplier from the questionnaire.
failure_modes: No address, so no payable site
Payment terms not matching an Oracle value

nodes.title: Ramp
nodes.subtitle: card & reimbursement
nodes.description: Corporate card and out-of-pocket reimbursement. Also an Accounting Hub subledger (source FAH-Ramp).

nodes.title: SimpleLegal
nodes.subtitle: legal spend
nodes.description: Legal invoices in, invoice status out. Supplier synchronisation is a known gap.
failure_modes: Supplier data out of sync causes AP invoicing errors

nodes.title: Payments Platform · Event Enrichment
nodes.subtitle: platform events
nodes.description: Marketplace payment events, enriched by Event Enrichment, delivered via S3 and OIC. Payments Platform alone is about 2M transactions a day.

nodes.title: Workday · CloudPay
nodes.subtitle: HR & payroll
nodes.description: Payroll journals, worker data and Workday Finance links to the Accounting Hub.

nodes.title: ReconArt · Clearwater · Spacebase
nodes.subtitle: other feeders
nodes.description: Cash reconciliation, investments and real-estate journals, pre-accounted into GL.

nodes.title: Oracle Integration Cloud
nodes.subtitle: INT### · monitored
nodes.description: Transactional and near-real-time flows. Failures raise PROD | ERROR | INT### tickets in the implementation project automatically.

nodes.title: Airflow
nodes.subtitle: EPM loads
nodes.description: Period-driven bulk movement into FCCS and ARCS. Pausing a DAG during tie-out is a normal close step, not an incident.

nodes.title: FBDI · ADFDI · EIB
nodes.subtitle: bulk loads
nodes.description: Bulk loads. Failures appear as import-process errors inside Oracle, not as tickets.
failure_modes: CVR rejections, even at zero balance

nodes.title: BICC · BI Publisher
nodes.subtitle: extracts
nodes.description: Warehouse and downstream extracts. This lane fails silently: blank files have shipped for long periods before detection.
failure_modes: Blank or missing extract, no ticket

nodes.title: Suppliers
nodes.subtitle: supplier master
nodes.description: Supplier profile, sites, bank accounts, payment methods, tax and 1099 attributes. Two creation paths feed it.

nodes.title: Self-Service Procurement
nodes.subtitle: requisitions
nodes.description: Receives Zip requisitions, re-derives the charge account, runs *_VAL validations and CVRs. First point in SOX scope.
failure_modes: CVR rejects a combination Zip accepted
Approver on leave stalls the chain

nodes.title: Purchasing
nodes.subtitle: POs & receipts
nodes.description: Purchase orders, change orders and receipts. Receipt is the first accounting event (accrual). Charge accounts come from the Transaction Account Builder.

nodes.title: Payables
nodes.subtitle: invoices & holds
nodes.description: Invoice matching, tolerances and holds. Tolerances are held per business unit in local currency and recalculated monthly.

nodes.title: Payments
nodes.subtitle: PPRs & files
nodes.description: Payment process requests per legal entity and bank account. Standard payments auto-approve in Kyriba because approval sits in Oracle.
failure_modes: Payment reason too long for the file

nodes.title: Expenses
nodes.subtitle: reimbursements
nodes.description: Oracle Expenses runs alongside Ramp. Approved reports become Payables invoices.

nodes.title: Accounting Hub
nodes.subtitle: platform accounting
nodes.description: Turns 10 to 12M daily events into about 40M lines and 3.5M GL lines in a 5 to 7 hour run. Succeeds about 99% of the time; the rest is throughput.

nodes.title: Fixed Assets
nodes.subtitle: 40+ books
nodes.description: Additions arrive mostly as mass additions from Payables. Corporate and tax books run in parallel.
failure_modes: Cost stranded in clearing when additions are held

nodes.title: Cash Mgmt · Receivables
nodes.subtitle: bank & minimal AR
nodes.description: Bank statements and reconciliation; Receivables only for a small B2B and intercompany population.

nodes.title: Subledger Accounting
nodes.subtitle: CORP_GAAP_SLAM
nodes.description: One engine for every subledger and every Accounting Hub source: event classes, journal entry rule sets, journal line rules, account rules, mapping sets. One place to change policy and one place that can strand transactions.
failure_modes: Accounting method left Incomplete after a rule change

nodes.title: General Ledger
nodes.subtitle: GAAP primary · STAT/TAX secondary
nodes.description: Corp_COA_Structure, nine segments. The only place completeness can be asserted. Receives derived journals from XLA and pre-accounted journals from 19+ feeders.

nodes.title: FCCS
nodes.subtitle: consolidation
nodes.description: Application CORPCONS: multi-GAAP, traditional balance sheet, CTA on balance sheet. Loads GL through a custom BIP trial balance registered as an ESS job.

nodes.title: ARCS
nodes.subtitle: reconciliation
nodes.description: Reconciliation Compliance and Transaction Matching. Auto-certifies within ±5,000 USD or zero difference with zero activity.

nodes.title: Warehouse · Snowflake
nodes.subtitle: reporting
nodes.description: Finance Warehouse, Snowflake and FAH fact tables. A second reporting platform with a standing reconciliation obligation to GL and no single owner.

nodes.title: Planning · Anaplan · EPBCS
nodes.subtitle: planning
nodes.description: Actuals and master data out to planning.

nodes.title: Kyriba → banks
nodes.subtitle: payment factory
nodes.description: Derives the bank payment code (DOMW domestic, INTW international), translates to bank format, transmits host-to-host, returns acknowledgements hourly. Source of truth for payment-code mapping.
failure_modes: Stuck in Draft with no Oracle signal
No ack: the bank has not received it

p2p.title: Procure to Pay: eight stages
p2p.lede: Zip orchestrates, Oracle decides. The first four stages move a commitment without touching the ledger. Receipt, invoice and payment each create accounting through Subledger Accounting under CORP_GAAP_SLAM. Bank outcomes return hourly and can cancel a payment Oracle already considers made.

stages.title: Supplier onboarding
stages.what: Two creation paths into one supplier master
stages.breaks: No address or unmatched terms fails creation

stages.title: Intake
stages.breaks: Inactive spend category: request never arrives

stages.title: Requisition
stages.what: Charge account re-derived; *_VAL rules and CVRs; first point in SOX scope

stages.title: Purchase order
stages.what: Change orders by Procurement Ops; FBDI for volume

stages.title: Receipt
stages.what: Third leg of the match; variable accrual via INT026F

stages.title: Invoice
stages.what: Matching, tolerances, holds; INT826 terms exceptions; INT960 non-PO over 5K

stages.title: Payment
stages.what: PPR per entity and bank account; auto-approved in Kyriba; urgent payments released by Treasury

stages.title: Settlement
stages.what: Two code mappings; host-to-host; hourly acks via INT955 and INT955B
stages.breaks: Stuck in Draft with no Oracle signal

notes.title: Spend category → code combination.
notes.text: Zip proposes segments through three chained lookups. Oracle re-derives the charge account, applies requisition validations and cross-validation rules, and stores the result. A mis-posting has two possible homes: compare what Zip sent with what Oracle stored.

notes.title: Holds are the Payables workload.
notes.text: 23,722 holds on 15,309 invoices in 12 months; 52% self-clear within an hour; median release 6.3 days, mean 17 days.

notes.title: No acknowledgement means the bank does not have the payment.
notes.text: Either transmission failed or the file is still in flight. Check Kyriba file status first.

onboarding.title: Two paths into the supplier master
onboarding.lede: PO suppliers are onboarded through Apex and arrive in Oracle through INT055A. Non-PO, ad hoc and Treasury payees are created in Oracle through the Supplier Registration Request and completed by INT959. Both land in the same supplier master.

steps.label: Apex portal
steps.text: Supplier completes questionnaires, risk, bank and tax detail; status Pending ERP

steps.label: INT055A · every 30 min
steps.text: Create or update by ERP Unique ID; banks and branches first; sites per company code from the enterprise-structure crosswalk

steps.label: Oracle Suppliers
steps.text: Header, addresses, sites, bank accounts, tax registrations, classifications; 1099 and CNPJ flags set automatically

steps.label: Feedback to Apex
steps.text: Oracle IDs back per record; errors to the Apex event log

lanes.title: Non-PO, ad hoc and Treasury payees

steps.label: Supplier Registration Request
steps.text: Internal Redwood form and questionnaire; six pages, bank accounts on page 5

steps.label: Internal registration approval
steps.text: Separate approval task from external registration

steps.label: INT959
steps.text: Completes profile, payment methods and tax flags from the questionnaire

notes.title: Crosswalk dependency.
notes.text: A new legal entity needs a row in the company-code crosswalk, or INT055A cannot create a supplier site for it.

notes.title: In flight on the SRR path.
notes.text: Address required at submission, selected payment method as default with others kept active, Tax Type and TRN/DUNS requiredness under analysis.

notes.title: Return legs.
notes.text: INT055B and INT055C send Oracle-side supplier changes back to Apex.

close.title: The close runs on a calendar, not on events
close.lede: Nineteen-plus feeders converge into GL, which then feeds FCCS, ARCS, planning and the warehouse on their own clocks. Most apparent system dependencies are sequencing dependencies.

timeline.what: INT955 Kyriba acknowledgements and rejections into Oracle; daily rejection summary to AP and Treasury
INT992 detects intercompany imbalance on 19500 and posts balancing journals
Platform accounting run: Event Enrichment → FAH → Create Accounting → GL → S3 facts
Monthly invoice-tolerance recalculation from the corporate rate
ReconArt bank balances load to ARCS
ReconArt unmatched items load to ARCS, on request
ARCS unmapped-accounts cycle: export, business assigns preparer and reviewer, profiles created
Open FCCS periods and approval units; create SOX and close task templates
FCCS load DAG runs; month-end and average rates to FCCS daily 17:00 UTC
Consolidation requests the FCCS load DAG be paused
Ad hoc loads after tax and transfer-pricing entries
Close periods and lock approval units
User access reviews; transfer-pricing revisions; Oracle release uptake

integrations.title: Integration register
integrations.lede: A strong sample assembled from production monitoring names and design documents, not a certified register. The lane a flow sits in tells you who operates it and where a failure surfaces.
